title: UAAP: UST girls cruise past UE to open HS volleyball campaign
summary: University of Santo Tomas is off to a bright start in the UAAP Season 89 girls' volleyball tournament, brushing aside the University of the East 25-18, 25-8, 25-10 on Saturday at Paco Arena in Manila.
